js: (() => { const d = document.getElementById('paper-frame').contentDocument; const ps = [...d.querySelectorAll('p')].filter(p => p.textContent.length > 200); const p = ps[3] || ps[0]; p.scrollIntoView({block:'center'}); const t = p.firstChild.nodeType === 3 ? p.firstChild : p; const r = d.createRange(); r.setStart(t, 0); r.setEnd(t, Math.min(90, t.textContent.length)); const s = d.getSelection(); s.removeAllRanges(); s.addRange(r); p.dispatchEvent(new MouseEvent('mouseup', {bubbles:true, button:0})); return s.toString(); })()

(() => { const out = {}; const f = document.getElementById('paper-frame'); const fr = f.getBoundingClientRect(); const d = f.contentDocument; const h = d?.querySelector('mark, .hl, [data-highlight], .lx-hl'); if (h) { const r = h.getBoundingClientRect(); out.highlight = [fr.x + r.x + 20, fr.y + r.y + r.height/2]; } const c = document.querySelector('.lx-card, .margin-card, .mcard'); if (c) { const r = c.getBoundingClientRect(); out.card = [r.x + 30, r.y + 30]; } const img = d?.querySelector('img'); if (img) { img.scrollIntoView({block:'center'}); } return JSON.stringify(out); })()

(() => { const d = document.getElementById('paper-frame').contentDocument; const a = [...d.querySelectorAll('a[href^="#"]')][5]; if (!a) return 'none'; a.scrollIntoView({block:'center'}); a.click(); return a.getAttribute('href'); })()
